_comment: OpenClaw command descriptor for Tier 2 local video generation through ComfyUI/Wan.
name: generate_video
description: Generate a short motion clip, hero loop, product loop, or image-to-video animation through the local ComfyUI video workflow.
trigger_examples: animate this still into a five second hero loop
make a slow cinematic push-in from the estate hero image
generate a short product motion clip for the fragrance

name.description: Output base name, e.g. estate-loop or crushed-motion

prompt.description: Motion prompt to pass to ComfyUI/Wan

image.description: Optional still image path for image-to-video mode

returns: Relay the line beginning VIDEO_RESULT_JSON= back to the user.
notes: Posting or publishing generated video is a separate approval-gated step unless the user explicitly requested local-only generation.
